opening.argument: The presentation centers on maximizing a compensation plan through personally recruited business, not merely discussing tokens. It requires personal referrals, including the example that “you personally referred $5,500 in business in your first month,” and illustrates recovering half of a $5,000 starting amount by recruiting two participants: “if you if you start at five grand right and you for two people for five grand you basically get half your money back already.” It further promotes payment from signups across an expanding network, asking whether one could be paid if someone signs up “in China, in Australia, in anywhere in the world.” The closing instruction, “take action now and welcome, to the world of cryptocurrency,” reinforces the recruitment-driven solicitation.
